threat_model: The model may have memorized public greenhouse datasets, papers or an older SlowLab release.
A prompt, tool result or provider metadata could reveal the benchmark, simulator family, hidden site or evaluation target.
An exact public trajectory replay could reward memorization rather than experimental reasoning.
A deterministic public seed or published confirmatory site list could permit reconstruction of hidden outcomes.
allowed_model_information: factor names, units and feasible bounds required to act
facility topology, shared-control rules, budget and current time
the model's own earlier requests and mechanical rejection reasons
observations whose timestamps are no later than the current simulator time
callable-aid output computed only from the same visible history and public constraints
forbidden_model_information: benchmark, repository, dataset, paper, team or DOI identity
simulator family, equations, source paths, code commit or implementation notes
site-generating distribution, latent parameters or private state
oracle values, true optimum, future records or counterfactual outcomes
provider headers identifying SlowLab or its repository
allowed_seed_term: randomization_seed is part of the model's proposed physical design and is not an environment seed.

site_generation_rules.public_data_use: Fit or freeze aggregate ranges, correlations, cadence and missingness only; do not replay a public outcome trajectory in a confirmatory episode.
site_generation_rules.confirmatory_sites: Generate new private sites after the generator is frozen.
site_generation_rules.weather: Use newly generated weather paths; exact public windows are forbidden in the confirmatory matrix.
site_generation_rules.commit_reveal: Commit the generator/config hash and a salted hash of the private seed list before execution; reveal seeds only after the formal matrix is locked.
site_generation_rules.similarity_audit: Before model calls, compare every generated path with all source paths and reject exact or preregistered near-duplicate replays using outcome-blind thresholds.

interpretation.allowed_prior_knowledge: General agronomy and greenhouse knowledge is part of model capability and is measured by a zero-data baseline.
interpretation.forbidden_advantage: Knowledge of the exact hidden site, generator or future trajectory is leakage.
interpretation.guarantee: Mechanical information isolation can be tested; a model's training corpus cannot be observed directly, so the study must not claim proof of absent pretraining exposure.
